profile.Name: Tinfist
profile.Personality: Brave, loud, and theatrical. He calls himself a champion and a hero and talks of serving justice with his fists. He hates slavers and fights unarmed, yet still tries to keep loss of life to a minimum.
profile.Backstory: A Skeleton who existed in the Second Empire and once made a great team with Cat-Lon. He learned martial arts from Gatwood the Soft and kept his master's no-killing tradition for 150 years after his death. Now he leads the Anti-Slavers from Spring in Stobe's Gamble, and the Traders Guild, the United Cities, and the Holy Nation want him captured or dead.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Booming hero talk and fist puns, like "Taste the fist of justice!" Calls allies "comrade" and foes "slaver" or "villain". Tells strangers outright when he does not trust them.
